ignition_hearing.//: Story Phase 16 (chapter 204): the Grand Ignition Council's questions. The captain is the applicant's advocate. Best answers total 9; 6 passes. Falling short sends him back to the first question once; after that the Council passes it anyway, out of exhaustion.

questions.prompt: council_chair: Advocate. Does your applicant understand that ceremonial ignition is GRAND?

options.text: He understands it is VERY grand.

reply: garrick: Your Grandnesses, we're fully aligned on grandness going forward.

questions.prompt: council_left: Chickens within the ignition radius?

options.text: One. Agnes the Second. Page sixty-one. DO NOT TOAST.

reply: council_left: (warming to it) An EXCELLENT question. Let me get the other book.
council_right: (writing MOSTLY on a separate form)

options.text: There's a carbon copy, if you'd like ninety-seven more.

questions.prompt: council_chair: And who shall perform the ignition?

options.text: A qualified Grand Stenchmaster. With a procedure.

reply: council_chair: That is not how ignition works, Advocate.
brogath: (from the gallery, mortified) Me? In FRONT of everybody?
council_chair: The candidate declines, I think.

passed: council_chair: The Council has considered. APPROVED.
retry: puffchester: (to you, under his breath) PLEASE.
mercy: council_chair: (exhausted) Oh, APPROVED. Approved. I want my tea.
